Bug_Title: Classes extending java.lang.Thread should provide a specific "run" behavior
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the MyThread class, which extends java.lang.Thread but does not override the run method. As a result, when an instance of MyThread is started, it does not perform any action because the default run method does nothing.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by creating an instance of MyThreadExample and calling its showBug method. Since MyThread does not override the run method, starting the thread results in no action being performed, which is verified by checking the returned message.
